html:
Primary

The one action

One per view. The thing the page exists to do — , , . Purple edge fire. If everything is primary, nothing is. Never place two primaries side by side.Create AppPublishSave

Secondary

The supporting action

Important but not the point — , , . Same obsidian body, silver-white fire. Sits beside a primary without competing. Use for paired actions and toolbars.View DetailsExportDuplicate

Ghost

The quiet exit

Low-stakes, reversible, or dismissive — , , . Transparent body, hairline only, the softest breathing in the set. Never use ghost for the main action; never use it on busy backgrounds.CancelNot nowLearn more

Danger

The irreversible action

Destructive or hard to undo — , , . Red edge fire, always paired with a confirmation. Never the default button in a dialog. Never for warnings that aren't destructive.DeleteRemove accessEnd session

Icon-only

The familiar symbol

Only when the glyph is unambiguous — add, search, more. Always with . 52px touch target, 44px minimum at . If a label would prevent a mistake, use a labeled button.＋⌕⋯aria-label--sm

The Laws

Non-negotiables

One DNA across every app — never restyle locally. Sentence-case labels, verb first. 44px minimum touch target. Focus ignites like hover. Disabled never ignites. Fire is 5%: if a screen glows at rest, it's wrong.

One brain, many doors — and every door looks like it belongs.

Lighting✦

White edge light at rest — 1.5px minimum, visible. Own color ignites on hover. Selection shows white only, never permanent color glow.

Color jobs△

Chrome is purple edge, white text. Text is white 99%, separated by size. Theme follows the spectrum per element. Never cross the jobs.

Buttons✧

Black heart (#050505), white voice plus icon, visible 1.5px skin, elevated. The glyph promises the action — plus means add, chevron means go.

Typography◆

24 / 18 / 14. Body 17–18px, floor 16px. Display type gets a real voice with crafted light — gradient or carved, layered shadows, breathing glow.

Icons✦

Drawn vector geometry, readable at 16px, native to the page. No shrunken renders. If you can’t make it good, don’t place it.

Header△

Logo top-left, living mark, warm voice, one clear line. Composed, not assembled. It breathes with the page — a front door, not a nameplate.

Aliveness✧

Ambient drift, edge breathing, rotating sheens, glow pulses — 4-second cycles minimum, slow and purposeful. Reduced motion disables everything.

Gates◆

9.0 to ship — scored on the rendered experience, never the code. Self-scorecard mandatory. Verify before claiming. No exceptions.
